latestVersion.changelog:
green-wood-spoon-carving-basics v1.0.0

- Initial release of skill for turning fresh-cut hardwood branches into custom, food-safe spoons and utensils with only hand tools.
- Agent automates species identification (using photos/GPS), calculates shrinkage/drying, produces ready-to-trace templates, and manages tracking and reminders.
- Clear division of labor: agent handles all analysis, checklists, and schedules; human performs all hands-on carving and finishing.
- Step-by-step, 14-day protocol covers wood selection, carving, drying, finishing, oiling, and testing.
- Includes progress checklists, barter/inventory templates, troubleshooting, and batch improvement routines.
